name: Media ridgelines in 3D
doc: The picture's scanlines stood up in 3D as ridgelines, each row a dark curtain (showing the picture dimly) whose glowing top edge is that row raised by its brightness and coloured by the image (or the palette); kicks (the kick input, else onsets) push the peaks up, the bass lifts them, a glow runs back through the rows each beat, seen along one of five camera paths (orbit, flyover, top-down, crane, arc).

palette.doc: lines (colour mode: palette), ground and sky

height.doc: peak height, share of the field's half width

kick.doc: kick level (bind an envelope); onsets stand in when it is lower

punch.doc: how far a full kick pushes the peaks up

fill.doc: how much a curtain hides the rows behind it

face.doc: how bright the picture shows on the curtains

swing.doc: orbit: how far the camera swings around (radians)

spin.doc: orbit: speed of a second, slower sway
